method: Web search for properties at each overnight point on the Lodi route. Names, addresses and exits come from the listed sources. Nothing was checked for price or availability on these dates, and nothing is booked.

nights.riskNote: Large I-40 hotel cluster. The only issue is the hour you roll in.
nights.action: Book ahead and flag the late arrival so the room is held past 22:00.

primary.name: Any I-40 exit 64-72 chain
primary.note: Hampton, Holiday Inn Express, La Quinta all sit here

nights.riskNote: Gallup is a Route 66 town where nearly every hotel sits on the old highway beside an I-40 exit.
nights.action: Exit 26 on the east side has the most chains and you are heading west, so it is on your way in.

alternates.name: Holiday Inn Express / Fairfield Inn / Sleep Inn

nights.riskNote: Yermo is a wide spot on I-15 with two motels. Fine if they have room, nothing nearby if they do not.
nights.action: Sleep in Barstow instead, 11 miles south on I-15 and still on your line. Far more choice and better rated.

primary.name: Comfort Suites Barstow
primary.note: best reviewed of the Barstow cluster

alternates.name: Travelodge by Wyndham Yermo
alternates.note: closest to the planned stop, 5 mi from Calico Ghost Town

nights.riskNote: SFO peninsula: the most expensive night of the trip, and parking is charged on top of the room, typically $30-35.
nights.action: Book TWO nights here, Monday and Tuesday. You sweep the Bay Area on Tuesday and come back to the same bed, so there is no reason to move hotels.

primary.name: Hampton Inn & Suites Burlingame Airport South

alternates.name: Courtyard San Francisco Airport Burlingame
alternates.note: ~3 mi from SFO, refundable rates listed

alternates.name: Red Roof PLUS+ San Francisco Airport

nights.charging: Start Tuesday's sweep with a low battery on purpose. The whole day depends on having room in the pack to keep taking charge.

nights.riskNote: Second night of the Burlingame booking. Nothing to arrange.
nights.action: No move. Sweep day ends where it started.

nights.riskNote: Huge choice, but it is the night before Thanksgiving and LA prices and traffic both spike.
nights.action: Book TWO nights, Wednesday and Thursday, somewhere central to the basin so Thursday's sweep does not start with an hour of freeway. Burbank, Glendale or the mid-city area all work.

primary.name: Burbank / Glendale chain
primary.note: close to the Tesla Diner leg of Thursday

alternates.name: El Segundo / LAX
alternates.note: cheaper, further from the north sites

nights.riskNote: Thanksgiving Day, and the sweep runs until nearly 19:00. Most restaurants will be shut by the time you finish.
nights.action: Sort Thanksgiving dinner before you set off that morning. The Tesla Diner is on this day's route and is open late, which may solve it outright.

nights.riskNote: East Phoenix metro, large chain cluster around the 101 and I-10.
Big I-10 city, plenty of rooms, and you are back in Central time.
nights.action: Easiest night. Sunday is a 578-mile run home, so get to bed early.
